entities.name: Roma and Sinti
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Originally from northern India (Rajasthan), the Roma migrated westward beginning around 1000 CE. Despite centuries of persecution — slavery in Romania, expulsion across Europe — they preserved their Romani language, music traditions (flamenco, jazz), and close-knit family structures.
